title: crate-jmap-chat-mimi-types: typed JMAP surface of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00
description: New workspace crate holding the wire types of the urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:mimi extension, so mimid and clients share one definition (replaces the plan in mimid-1wgh.12.2). Types only: no server logic. Byte-string properties are unpadded base64url of exact TLS-encoded octets (draft §Conventions): keep them as validated base64url strings, never re-encode. Follow workspace AGENTS.md conventions (extras preservation, non_exhaustive, serde camelCase, spec-quoted tests with hand-written JSON oracles from the draft's Examples section).
